type.title: CAPTCHA type
type.description: 0 image, 4 reCAPTCHA v2, 5 reCAPTCHA v3, 12 Turnstile, 16 Amazon WAF, 21 DataDome, 25 reCAPTCHA v2 Enterprise.

params.title: Type parameters
params.description: googlekey or sitekey, pageurl, action, min_score, iv, context... The key is chosen from the type, the same way the API clients do.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Optional. The client defaults to 60 seconds for image types and 120 for token types.
